verdict.rationale: Pulumi provides the building blocks for agent-safe workflows: preview (pulumi preview) as a no-op plan/review gate, CrossGuard policy-as-code guardrails, an MCP server for AI assistants, and Neo for agent-driven provisioning with 'enterprise controls'. However, there is no documented least-privilege credential scoping specific to agent execution, no explicit approval-gate workflow tying preview output to a required human sign-off before apply, and no independent evidence confirming these controls prevent unapproved changes in practice. missing for 10: least-privilege credential scoping for agents, explicit human-approval gate enforcement before apply, independent/hands-on verification that policy gates block agent-driven changes.
